data.content_ref: inline:SRC_04's 'compatibility' is conditional and thin: it says separation is unnecessary is compatible with the blind-spot theory only if adversarial-mode paths are statistically orthogonal to authoring paths, then refutes via sycophancy. But sycophancy (confirming prior outputs) is not the same failure as non-orthogonality of adversarial vs authoring paths; the refutation must show the adversarial mode traverses overlapping paths, not merely that it is biased toward self-confirmation. The stated refuter does not match the condition it negates.
